# gpui-navi

> AI-agent index.

- [404](/404/) — The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.
- [Architecture](/explanation/architecture/) — How the Navi crates layer from the pure routing engine up to framework adapters, and how a navigation flows through them.
- [Framework Agnosticism](/explanation/framework-agnosticism/) — Why Navi compiles the same route table for GPUI, Dioxus, Leptos, Xilem, and Floem — and what switching frameworks costs.
- [Performance Design](/explanation/performance/) — The allocation-free hot paths, bounded memory, and lock-free history behind Navi's benchmark numbers.
- [Route Matching](/explanation/route-matching/) — How the ranked radix trie matches locations in O(log n) and why static segments always beat dynamic ones.
- [Devtools](/guides/devtools/) — Open Navi's built-in devtools panel and use its Routes, Cache, Timeline, and State tabs to debug navigation, loaders, and blockers.
- [File-Based Routing](/guides/file-based-routing/) — Every route file naming convention in Navi — dynamic segments, splats, index routes, layouts, groups, and ignored files.
- [Installation](/guides/installation/) — Add the Navi crates to your Rust project, select your UI framework with a quoin feature flag, and wire up route-tree code generation.
- [Loaders & Suspense](/guides/loaders-and-suspense/) — Fetch route data with loaders backed by the rs-query cache, control staleness and GC, and render granular loading states with Awaited.
- [Navigation Blockers](/guides/navigation-blockers/) — Prevent navigation with sync or async blockers that guard unsaved changes and destructive in-progress work.
- [Link Preloading](/guides/preloading/) — Warm the loader cache before navigation with Render, Intent, and Viewport preload strategies and per-href deduplication.
- [Route Guards](/guides/route-guards/) — Protect routes with before_load hooks that redirect, 404, or allow navigation — plus on_enter and on_leave lifecycle callbacks.
- [Scroll Restoration](/guides/scroll-restoration/) — Restore scroll positions per path and query, bound the cache, and opt out per route or per navigation.
- [Search Params](/guides/search-params/) — Type your query strings with typed search structs, navigate with search values, and opt into nested bracket syntax with the nested-search feature.
- [Validation](/guides/validation/) — Integrate validator, garde, validify, or valico with Navi's ValidateSearch trait — one integration per crate, enforced per feature.
- [Navi](/) — A powerful file-based router for Rust UI frameworks — one route table, every frontend, powered by quoin.
- [Components](/reference/components/) — The router UI components — Link, Outlet, Awaited, SuspenseBoundary, ScrollRestoration — with their full builder surface.
- [Core Types](/reference/core-types/) — The engine types re-exported from navi-router-core — Location, RouteTree, RouterCore, NavigationEffect, and the rest.
- [Workspace Crates](/reference/crates/) — The seven crates of the gpui-navi workspace and what each one owns.
- [define_route!](/reference/define-route/) — Every argument accepted by the define_route! macro, its types, and defaults.
- [Macros](/reference/macros/) — The twelve procedural macros of navi-macros — signatures, what they expand to, and what they return.
- [navi.config.json](/reference/navi-config/) — Every key of the navi-codegen configuration file — types, defaults, and an example.
- [Runtime & Router Options](/reference/runtime/) — RouterProvider, RouterOptions, NotFoundMode, Navigator, and NavigateOptions — the runtime surface that boots and drives the router.
- [Getting Started](/tutorials/getting-started/) — Build a small routed application with Navi on GPUI — from empty Cargo project to loaders, layouts, and links.
